main_text.p: cisse; Scotum quidem & Gabrielem il-lum admisisse, sed ea ratione, ut illum po-tius destruerent, quàm astruerent: sta-tim enim subjiciunt, illius existentiam neque Scripturæ Sacræ autoritate, ne-que Patrum testimoniis probari posse. Hæc, inquam, omnia noverat Morinus; tamen asserit, post clarissimam Concilii Tridentini definitionem, statui debere, tanquam principium primum & per se notum, Characterem esse signum spirita-le & indelebile virtute Sacramenti animæ impressum. Imo addit, qualitatem esse specialem & indelebilem, quia Doctorum Ecclesiæ maxima pars in eam sententiam inclinare videtur; si autem quæramus, qui sint Doctores illi Ecclesiæ, à quibus hic totus dependet Morinus, iidem sunt, quos paulo antea velut homines imperitos, & rei, quam tractat, prorsus ignaros suggil-lavit: Ita quandoque bonus dormitat Mo-rinus. Iterum expendens quæstionem de iterandis ordinationibus, utrum sci-licet aliquando possint iterari, maximè cum agitur de Hæreticis, Schismaticis, depo-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Line-end hyphens are kept inside the words as printed (il-lum, po-tius, ne-que, spirita-le, suggil-lavit, Mo-rinus, sci-licet). The paragraph runs unbroken to the foot of the column, so it is one paragraph. The first word is a fragment ("cisse", from "cisse") and is kept as a fragment. The word "depo-" is continued on the following page. No catchword or signature is printed. The dark vertical stains on the right and the grey edge marks on the left are show-through or the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
